name: Mahoning County, OH
findings: Mahoning County has 1,010 nonprofit organizations. 367 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 304 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Mahoning County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 86 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 86 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Economic development organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 13 economic development organizations here list public events, compared with about 6 in similar places of this size.
